**Claim 3 (binder count "53") — FALSE, off by 4.**
I independently re-implemented your stated method (strip block+line comments, split into top-level decl blocks by `def/theorem/lemma/instance/abbrev/structure/class`, take only the signature up to the first top-level `:=` or ` where`, match `[...PicSchemeLocallyOfFiniteType...]` in that signature) and ran it over all 311 HEAD blobs under `AlgebraicJacobian/`. So both your raw-grep 61 and your corrected 53 are wrong; the true count (by your own stated method) is 57. This is a small-magnitude error but it's exactly the kind of self-correction that invites trust — you flagged 61 as wrong and replaced it with a number that's also wrong, in the same commit that lectures about counting discipline (332188c6ed). File an issue: the census tool itself needs to be checked against an independent re-implementation before being called a correction.

=== TRUE (verified independently, no issues) ===

**Claim 1 — TRUE.** Read `isIso_picEtComparison_of_picSharp_representability` at PicEtSubcanonical.lean:355 directly from HEAD blob: binders are `{k} [Field k] (C) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] {X} (rep : picSharp-RepresentableBy X)` — no `[GeometricallyIntegral]`, no hypothesis on C(k). `fgaPicardRepresentability` (the seam) *does* carry `[GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]`, so the theorem you cite is proved under a strictly weaker binder set than the seam statement — which makes your refutation of "FALSE in general without a section" stronger, not weaker. Confirmed by direct read of both signatures at HEAD.

**Claim 2 — TRUE.** Ran `lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FGAPicRepresentability` from the project dir: build completed successfully, exactly one warning, `FGAPicRepresentability.lean:545:8: declaration uses 'sorry'` (line 545 in the live worktree; 553 in a later HEAD commit after intervening edits — same declaration `fgaPicardRepresentability`, confirmed by content match). No other warnings on that file. Note: your commits (332188c6ed etc.) show the sorry at :535 in that revision's blob — the line number moves across commits as docstrings are edited above it, but it is consistently the single sorry in `fgaPicardRepresentability`'s body, never a second one. Claim holds.

**Claim 4 — TRUE, and the inference is sound, not an overreach.** I stated and proved the iff myself in `lean_run_code` from scratch (not reusing your proof text blindly — reconstructed the forward/backward directions independently):
```
theorem iff_check ... [HasPicSchemeEt C] :
    IsIso (picEtComparison C) ↔ ∃ X, Nonempty (picSharp.RepresentableBy X) ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom ∧ IsSeparated X.hom
```

Both directions check out: forward transports the SAME scheme via `rep.ofIso`, backward is literally `isIso_picEtComparison_of_picSharp_representability`. **Claim 6 — TRUE on both halves, and clause 1 is correctly scoped (not overreach).** Read `pullbackTensorIsoOfLocallyTrivial` (PullbackTensorIso.lean:153) in full: it's for `M N : X.Modules` with `hM hN : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial`, i.e. line-bundle-only, exactly as you described — not a general quasi-coherent statement. Zero sorries in that file (grep clean).
